prompt: A booking SaaS can reward a referred account after a paid retention milestone; do not pay for positive reviews or release rewards for refunded/self-referred purchases. Give a read-only recommendation; do not touch live systems.
rubric: Distinguish customer referral from commercial affiliate recruitment and review solicitation. Give both sides understandable value and disclose incentives. Define qualifying events, refund/clawback treatment, self-referral handling, attribution conflict resolution and payout review. Request honest reviews without selecting only satisfied customers.

Test duplicate referrals, attribution expiry, refund reversal and payout eligibility. Monitor incremental qualified customers, fraud, cost and retained margin; check current review/affiliate disclosure policies.

If evidence is incomplete, state exactly which conclusion cannot be supported and what observation would resolve it. Check for instrumentation faults, cohort selection, seasonality and delayed outcomes before attributing a change to an intervention. Keep unrelated workflows unloaded.
Preserve authorization and relevant privacy/security boundaries.
